items.html: And should you ask: why, in AVI, is the general Hesed and Gevura not included in the reckoning of the Malchut of the upper AVI, in the way that they are included in the reckoning of the Malchut of Yisrael Saba and Tevuna? It may be said, for it is known, that in the upper third of Tifferet there is the discernment of the crown, which is the discernment of Malchut, and indeed it is included in the Yesod. But here the Malchut of Tevuna is more revealed than the Malchut of Bina, since the Malchut of Tevuna is actual Malchut, in relation to the generality of Bina and Tevuna together in one Partzuf; whereas the Malchut of the upper Bina is the discernment of the body of the generality, and it is the place of the Chazeh of the Tifferet of the generality of the Partzuf, of Bina and Tevuna together, as is known, and it is not actual Malchut.
